import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import xarray as xr


def _load_case(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def _surface(case: dict[str, Any]) -> xr.DataArray:
    return xr.DataArray(
        np.asarray(case["values"], dtype=float),
        dims=("y", "x"),
        coords={
            "y": np.asarray(case["y"], dtype=float),
            "x": np.asarray(case["x"], dtype=float),
        },
        name="survey_surface",
        attrs={"crs": str(case["crs"])},
    )


def _remap_view(
    surface: xr.DataArray,
    case: dict[str, Any],
    view: dict[str, Any],
    method: str,
) -> np.ndarray:
    from xrspatial.reproject import reproject

    result = reproject(
        surface,
        target_crs=str(case["crs"]),
        bounds=tuple(float(v) for v in view["bounds"]),
        resolution=tuple(float(v) for v in view["resolution"]),
        resampling=method,
        nodata=float(case["nodata"]),
        transform_precision=0,
    )
    return np.asarray(result.values, dtype=float)

  - descending y / ascending x orientation;
